Dear Amazon Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong enthusiasm for the **Programmer Analyst Intern -- 2027** position at Amazon Development Centre India (Job ID: 10506542). Amazon's commitment to building highly available, customer-centric infrastructure that scales globally is an engineering mission I am eager to contribute to. I confirm that I am available for full-time commitment during the entire duration of the internship with zero academic or external project conflicts, and I am fully prepared to submit the required university declaration of availability.

My engineering background directly aligns with the technical and operational focus of the Programmer Analyst role:

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.2in, itemsep=2pt, topsep=1pt]
    \item \textbf{Core CS Fundamentals \& Clean Coding (Java Preferred):} Grounded in algorithmic rigor, I have solved \textbf{1200+ DSA problems} across LeetCode, CodeChef, and GeeksforGeeks. I write clean, maintainable code in \textbf{Java}, C++, Python, and SQL, strictly following Object-Oriented Design and automated testing best practices.
    \item \textbf{AWS Cloud Technologies \& Schedulers (AWS S3, DynamoDB, EC2):} As a certified \textbf{AWS Cloud Practitioner}, I understand core AWS architectures. In \textbf{DBVault}, I engineered an automated scheduling and backup system supporting multiple database engines. I designed background queue workflows and job state machines using \textbf{Redis and BullMQ}, implementing worker concurrency, distributed locking, and automated offloading to \textbf{AWS S3} with \textbf{120+ unit and integration tests}.
    \item \textbf{Troubleshooting Complex Code \& Production Quality:} In my merged open-source contribution to \textbf{ESLint Core (PR \#21218)}, I diagnosed and resolved a subtle floating-point underflow bug under IEEE 754 specifications within an abstract syntax tree (AST) engine.     \item \textbf{Business-to-Technical Liaison \& Internal Tool Automation:} As a Web Developer with Students Special Group, I developed an internal \textbf{Project Management Portal} and a \textbf{Faculty Reward Points Dashboard}. \end{itemize}

Amazon's Leadership Principles---particularly \textit{Customer Obsession}, \textit{Invent and Simplify}, \textit{Ownership}, and \textit{Deliver Results}---guide how I build software every day. I welcome the opportunity to work closely with Amazon's senior engineers and managers, support platform migrations, automate operational bottlenecks, and deliver high-impact technology solutions for Amazon's teams and customers.

Thank you for your time, consideration, and review of my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my technical skills and operational passion can support Amazon's goals.
